_notes: SI units. Conversions: 1 kg·cm = 0.0980665 N·m; s/60° -> rad/s = (π/3)/t; rpm -> rad/s = rpm·2π/60.

'RATED_RULE': most hobby servos and Dynamixels publish only stall torque. Where no continuous rating is published, rated_torque_nm = stall/3, the ratio Feetech publishes for the STS3215 (6.5 / 19.5 kg·cm). Treat these as estimates.
Prices are single-unit retail and change often; they are for ranking designs, not quoting.
